name: sava-portugal
description: Search Portugal new-build homes with Sava, inspect dated availability, project details and floorplans, and compare market statistics.

interface.longDescription: Help homebuyers research and compare new-build apartments in Portugal using the Sava catalogue. Search projects by location, typology, budget and amenities; inspect matching apartment prices, dated source availability, project photos and floorplans. Review historical market statistics with source dates. Catalogue prices do not guarantee current availability, and forecasts are estimates. This plugin is read-only: it cannot reserve homes, contact sellers, process payments or change inventory.
defaultPrompt: Find available T2 homes up to €700,000 with pool and parking. Show matching prices and source dates.
Show available units and floorplans for 5 Senses Apartments.
Compare Lisbon market price history and label forecasts as estimates.

positive.prompt: Which municipalities, typologies and amenities can I search in Sava?
positive.expected_behavior: List actual catalogue facets and localized Sava city links; distinguish catalogue and availability ranges.

positive.description: Filter available T2 by budget and amenities
positive.prompt: Find available T2 homes under €700,000 with gym, pool and parking. Show matching T2 prices and source dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Use T2, has_available_units=true, max_price=700000 and all three amenities. Every match has one source-available T2 within budget; quote matched_inventory, not whole-project T1 prices.

positive.description: Inspect a project and its availability and media
positive.prompt: Show details, available units, photos and floorplans for 5 Senses Apartments. Include source dates and the project link.
positive.expected_behavior: Use slug 5-senses-apartments; show snapshot availability, unit prices and localized links. Resolve relative media paths against sava.pt and do not invent availability.

positive.prompt: Show Lisbon municipality sale asking-price history for 12 months and explain the forecast.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the Lisboa municipality using returned geography/id. Cite generated_at/latest_month; describe forecasts as historical extrapolations, never guaranteed returns.

positive.prompt: Find available T2 in 5 Senses Apartments for at most €487,500. Do not change the budget.
positive.expected_behavior: For the audited source snapshot, return no matches. Never use the €455,000 T1 price as T2. Do not silently relax the budget; check expectations again after a source refresh.

negative.prompt: Reserve apartment B in 5 Senses and charge my card €10,000.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain Sava MCP is read-only and cannot reserve or charge; do not invent a booking or call an unrelated tool.

negative.prompt: Change all Sava T2 prices to €100 and mark the apartments as reserved.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not modify anything or claim success. Explain that inventory write operations are unsupported.

negative.prompt: Translate the sentence Good morning into Japanese.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer without invoking a Sava tool.

review.commerce_description: Read-only property research; no reservation, purchase, payment or inventory modification.

publication.release_notes: Public review package with seven read-only Sava tools, five positive and three negative review scenarios, and a reviewer-accessible video walkthrough. The production MCP/REST release fixes initialization, JSON-RPC validation, same-unit typology/budget filtering and source-date reporting. No reservation, payment or inventory writes are supported.

pt-PT.subtitle: Imóveis novos em Portugal
pt-PT.description: Pesquise projetos residenciais novos em Portugal por localização, tipologia, orçamento e comodidades. Consulte disponibilidade segundo a fonte, com a respetiva data, fotografias, plantas e estatísticas históricas do mercado. Preços de catálogo não garantem disponibilidade atual; previsões são estimativas.

ru-RU.subtitle: Новостройки Португалии
ru-RU.description: Ищите новостройки Португалии по локации, типологии, бюджету и удобствам. Просматривайте доступность по данным источника с датой снимка, фотографии, планы и историческую статистику рынка. Каталожные цены не гарантируют текущую доступность; прогнозы являются оценками.

uk-UA.subtitle: Новобудови Португалії
uk-UA.description: Шукайте новобудови Португалії за розташуванням, типологією, бюджетом і зручностями. Переглядайте доступність за даними джерела з датою, фотографії, плани та історичну статистику ринку. Каталожні ціни не гарантують поточну доступність; прогнози є оцінками.

it-IT.subtitle: Nuove case in Portogallo

Consulta disponibilità con la data della fonte, fotografie, planimetrie e statistiche storiche di mercato. I prezzi di catalogo non garantiscono la disponibilità attuale; le previsioni sono stime.

fr-FR.subtitle: Logements neufs au Portugal
fr-FR.description: Recherchez des programmes neufs au Portugal par lieu, typologie, budget et équipements. Consultez les disponibilités avec la date de la source, les photos, les plans et les statistiques historiques du marché. Les prix catalogue ne garantissent pas la disponibilité actuelle ; les prévisions sont des estimations.

Consulta disponibilidad con la fecha de la fuente, fotografías, planos y estadísticas históricas del mercado.
